page_title: UNI 2-2 BAY | Union Berlin v Bayern Munich 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Florian Exner's book.
90+7' That's it for today, Florian Exner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) prepares to take a corner kick.

90+3' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) makes it 2:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Tom Bischof and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Frederik Ronnow was helpless.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' The attendance is 22012.
88' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florian Exner ignores the protests.
88' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) replacing Josip Stanisic.
83' 2 - 1 Goal! Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich). Florian Exner doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' Here comes a substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Leon Goretzka.
80' Here is a change. Konrad Laimer is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich).
78' The substitution is prepared. Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tom Rothe.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilyas Ansah trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
78' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Oliver Burke and he is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
77' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Manuel Neuer was alert and made a comfortable save.
76' An attempted cross from Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is cleared.
72' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
71' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
71' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) will replace Aljoscha Kemlein.
70' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) replaces Janik Haberer.
69' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
67' The shots on goal statistics – 3:3.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
63' The foul by Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Exner.
61' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

60' Frederik Ronnow was forced into action to thwart Michael Olise (Bayern Munich). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
59' That will be all from Serge Gnabry who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich).
59' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
57' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
57' Union Berlin keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
52' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
48' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take a corner kick.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Harry Kane plays a lovely pass into Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
44' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
42' The ball possession is 30:70.
41' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.
36' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.
36' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) for a tough tackle.
35' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Michael Olise darts into free space to control the ball.
32' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
31' Bayern Munich keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
30' The Union Berlin players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
30' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

27' 1 - 0 Janik Haberer produces a sweet pass and picks out Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:0!
26' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) will take the corner.
25' A long pass, executed by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Union Berlin.
24' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.
22' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
22' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick.
21' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) and Harry Kane perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
20' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take the free kick.
17' Some patient build-up play from Bayern Munich as they look to unlock the defence.
17' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
15' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
14' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
13' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
13' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florian Exner blows for a foul.
11' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Union Berlin players look gutted.
10' The Union Berlin players halt their celebrations as referee Florian Exner makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
10' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) finds the back of the net after rising highest in the penalty area to head the ball inside the right post!
9' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
7' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
6' Nice passing game by Bayern Munich. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
4' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Florian Exner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rani Khedira (Union Berlin).
3' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' The free kick from Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Union Berlin have a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Florian Exner.
